why_the_extra_day: A sample late in a UTC day falls on the next Beijing calendar day, so 2026-01-01 is required.

daily_fields.temp_mean_C: daily mean air temperature at 2 m, deg C
daily_fields.temp_max_C: daily maximum air temperature at 2 m, deg C
daily_fields.temp_min_C: daily minimum air temperature at 2 m, deg C
daily_fields.rh_pct: daily mean relative humidity at 2 m, percent
daily_fields.rain_mm: daily liquid rain, mm; retained, not used by the link model
daily_fields.wind_max_kmh: daily maximum wind speed at 10 m, km/h

source_2025: Previously stored daily values for the requested point. The forecast model and the original API response were not retained.
pressure_note: Surface pressure is the grid-point value. It is not reduced from the 52 m grid elevation to the 387 m station.
